integration.dev.help: Automatically finds a running compatible host. New connections require permission approval; you can also connect manually.
integration.dev.failed: Connection failed. Check that the other app is running and that a different connection is not already registered.
integration.dev.selectHost: Select a running Kawaikara Dev instance.
integration.dev.pendingDisconnect: Disconnect pending. It will be delivered when Kawaikara Dev runs again.
integration.title: Kawaikara integration
integration.description: Send videos from Kawaikara to select and download clips here. Registration and permissions are approved in Kawaikara.
integration.open: Open Kawaikara to set up integration
integration.opened: Launch requested. In Kawaikara's external app settings, register kawai-downloader and allow the desired Providers. Opening the app does not grant integration permissions.
integration.failed: Could not open Kawaikara. Install and launch it once, then try again.
appInfo.description: Preview videos and download precisely selected clips.
cookies.genericGuide: Import a Netscape cookies.txt containing only the sites you want to use. Cookies are kept in a separate jar and yt-dlp applies domain matching. They are not injected into the preview browser; some authenticated previews may fail even when downloading works. Browser-wide extraction is disabled here to avoid retaining unrelated account credentials.
cookies.genericFileOnly: For other sites, import a site-scoped Netscape cookie file.
preview.collectionUnsupported: This URL is a playlist or collection. Paste an individual video URL.
preview.drmUnsupported: This video is DRM-protected and cannot be previewed or downloaded by this app.
cookies.closeBrowserDescription: {browser} is still running. To extract cookies, fully quit the browser and its background processes, not just its windows.
cookies.closeBrowserMac: Choose Quit from the {browser} menu (⌘Q). Save any unfinished work first. This app will not force the browser to close.
cookies.closeBrowserOther: Choose Exit from the {browser} menu and quit any remaining background processes. Save unfinished work first. This app will not force the browser to close.
selection.clamp.help: Keep the playhead inside the selected range.
selection.follow.help: Extend the crossed start or end to follow the playhead.
selection.free.help: Seek and play independently of the selection.
encoding.copyPresetHelp: Replaces the manual options and file format above with the FFmpeg settings for ‘{preset}’. You can then edit them as needed.
cookies.profilesHelp: Choose the profile signed in to the selected site. The actual profile folder name is shown in parentheses.
cookies.profilesEmpty: No profiles found in standard locations. Use automatic selection or enter a profile folder name manually.
cookies.profilesFailed: Could not read profile names. Refresh or enter a profile folder name manually.
encoding.help: Output options only. The app manages input (-i), time ranges and output paths. Supports codec, quality, bitrate, frame rate and basic scale/fps/crop/pad video filters.
encoding.invalidOptions: Unsupported option or invalid value. Enter output options, not a full command, input file or output path.
cookies.keychainAccessFailed: Could not retrieve the browser key from Keychain. Access may be denied or the key may be missing. Check Keychain Access, then retry.
cookies.permissionDenied: Cookie file access was denied. Check macOS file permissions. Development runs may require permission for the launching Electron app or terminal.
cookies.settingsUnavailable: Could not open permission settings. Open System Settings or Keychain Access manually.
cookies.macPermissionHelp: Fully quit the browser, then choose Authorize & extract. This requests macOS Keychain access when needed and continues with extraction. Check the requesting program (security). One-time permission may require another prompt during extraction. No dialog appears if access is already allowed or the key is missing.
cookies.developmentPermissions: Running in pnpm start development mode. Only for file-access errors, open the actual Electron.app location and Full Disk Access settings below. Add the selected app if needed and restart the development app. Permission may instead belong to the launching terminal. A Keychain error alone does not require Full Disk Access.
cookies.working: Processing request. Check the system authorization dialog if it appears.
cookies.keychainMissing: The browser's Safe Storage key is missing. Sign in using that browser first.
cookies.noKeychainRequest: Keychain authorization is unavailable for this browser or operating system.
shortcut.editHelp: Click a key label and press a new combination. Esc cancels; Backspace/Delete clears. Save to apply.
shortcut.unsupported: Unsupported key combination or conflicts with the app’s default editing/closing shortcuts.
cookies.extractGuide: 1. Sign into the selected site in your browser. 2. Fully quit the browser, including background processes. 3. Click Extract. macOS may ask for Keychain access. If OS encryption prevents extraction, import a cookies.txt file for that site. Import and Clear affect only the selected site.
cookies.browserRunning: Browser running — waiting for it to fully close. It will not be closed or extracted automatically.
cookies.browserReady: Browser closed — click Extract when ready.
cookies.processCheckFailed: Cannot check browser processes. Retry shortly or import a cookie file.
preference.hardwareAccelerationDescripti: Use the GPU for video previews and rendering. On by default. Save changes, fully quit the app, and reopen it to apply.
cookies.invalidProfile: Enter a profile name, not a path, e.g. Default or Profile 1.
cookies.browserTimeout: Import timed out. Close the browser and try again.
cookies.browserBusy: Another cookie import is in progress.
cookies.browserMissing: Browser cookies were not found. Sign into the selected site in this browser/profile.
cookies.browserLocked: The browser is using its cookie database. Quit it completely and try again.
cookies.decryptFailed: Browser encryption prevented reading cookies. Try Firefox or import a cookies.txt file.
cookies.browserFailed: Could not import browser cookies. Check the browser/profile or import from a file.
cookies.title: Site login cookies
cookies.description: Select the browser where you are signed into YouTube. Extraction temporarily reads the browser cookie jar; only YouTube/Google cookies are retained. Browser encryption may prevent direct import.
cookies.previewApplied: Cookies copied to the preview session. Sign-in and video access have not been verified.
cookies.previewFailed: Download cookies were saved, but preview application failed. Import again.
preview.checking: Checking the preview stream, using cookies for this site if available…
preview.expired: Saved cookies have expired or rotated. Check that this video plays in Chrome, fully quit Chrome, then extract cookies again in Preferences.
preview.denied: This account cannot access the video. Import cookies from a browser profile with viewing permission. Saving cookies does not confirm video access.
preview.unavailable: Video information is accessible, but no compatible preview stream is available. Download availability is separate.
preview.failed: Could not check the preview. Check your network and cookies, then click Load to retry.
preview.streamFailed: Video information is accessible, but the preview stream could not play. Click Load to request a fresh URL.
cookies.importComplete: Cookies imported. Check the application status below.
cookies.cleared: Saved cookies and preview authentication cleared.
cookies.appliesImmediately: Import and clear affect downloads and previews. The current video reloads while keeping selected ranges. Video access, expired authentication, and playback restrictions are still checked separately.
cookies.invalid: Choose a Netscape-format cookies.txt file no larger than 1 MB.
cookies.empty: No valid cookies for the selected site. Check the site selection and browser login.
cookies.readFailed: Could not read cookie settings. Import cookies again.
cookies.saveFailed: Could not change cookie settings. Check file access and try again.
ytDlpUpdate.title: yt-dlp automatic updates
ytDlpUpdate.description: On startup, the app checks the official latest release, verifies it and installs it automatically. Active downloads keep their current version.
ytDlpUpdate.updated: Updated. New downloads will use the new version.
ytDlpUpdate.error: Could not check or install the update. Keeping the existing version if available.
ytDlpUpdate.managed: External workers and explicitly configured yt-dlp binaries are managed by their host environment.
app.title: Section Download
app.description: Choose sections in the preview and save them in a format suited to your editing workflow.
tabs.label: Video tabs
viewer.label: Video viewer
viewer.description: This viewer and its section editor belong only to the current tab.
preference.windowDescription: Manage language and behavior shared by the application.
preference.playbackStepsDescription: These values immediately change the labels and movement distance of the transport buttons.
preference.frameRateDescription: YouTube does not expose the source FPS to the player, so one-frame movement uses this value.
preference.automaticUpdatesDescription: Check for new app releases automatically. yt-dlp updates separately at startup; FFmpeg uses the version supplied with the app.
locale.label: Language
source.urlPlaceholder: Paste a video URL from a site supported by yt-dlp
video.placeholder: Enter a URL to show the preview here.
timeline.label: Playback timeline
timeline.dragRuler: Drag the time ruler to change the playback position
playback.dragPosition: Drag to change the playback position
range.label: Download range
range.dragStart: Drag to change the start point
range.dragEnd: Drag to change the end point
segments.label: Sections to save
segments.duplicate: This section has already been added
segments.empty: Set the start and end points, then add a section.
dependency.label: Required tools status
download.workspaceDescription: Prepare the current tab's sections for the queue, then return to the video without losing your edit state.
download.destinationDescription: Choose the output file name and where completed clips will be saved.
download.sectionsDescription: Click a section to pause playback and highlight it on the timeline.
download.sectionsEmpty: Load a video and choose the sections to save.
download.optionsDescription: Choose quality, speed limit and the format for your editing workflow.
preset.youtubeCopy.name: Keep source format
preset.dnxhr.target: Intermediate codec for DaVinci Resolve editing
queue.label: Download queue
queue.windowDescription: Monitor every tab's downloads in one shared queue window.
status.invalidUrl: Enter a public HTTP(S) video URL supported by yt-dlp.
status.rangeReset: The download range was reset to the full video. Saved sections were kept.
status.invalidLinkRange: The link range was invalid, so the full video was selected.
status.linkStartApplied: The link start time was applied as the section start.
status.linkRangeApplied: The link time range was applied to the section.
status.segmentListCount: There are {count} sections in the list.
status.setRangeFirst: Set the start and end points first.
status.endAfterStart: The end point must be after the start point.
status.addNewSegmentFirst: Add a new section that is not already in the queue.
status.queueSegmentsAdded: Added {count} new sections to the existing queue item.
status.invalidSavedUrl: The saved queue item has an invalid video URL.
status.queueLoadFailed: Could not load the saved download queue.
queue.message.resume: Resuming from the last completed section
queue.message.resumeQueued: Waiting to resume from the last completed section
queue.message.removing: Stopping and removing the job from the queue
queue.message.addedRunning: {count} sections added · will continue after the current job
queue.message.resumeAfterRestart: Waiting to resume after app restart
main.progress.alreadyComplete: All requested sections are already complete; nothing was downloaded again.
main.progress.downloadingSource: Downloading the source video to a temporary file.
main.progress.refreshingMediaUrl: The media URL was rejected; retrying with a freshly extracted URL.
main.progress.updatingYtDlp: Checking and preparing the latest yt-dlp version.
main.progress.cuttingCopy: Cutting section {current}/{total} while keeping the source streams.
main.error.invalidUrl: Enter a public HTTP(S) video URL supported by yt-dlp.
main.error.tooManySegments: Select no more than 100 sections at a time.
main.error.invalidSegment: The end point of section {index} must be after its start point.
main.error.segmentTooLong: Section {index} is too long. Select a range of 6 hours or less.
main.error.binaryMissing: Could not find {name}. Install it on PATH or specify its location with the {env} environment variable.
main.error.ytDlpOutdated: yt-dlp {version} is too old for current YouTube downloads. Update it to {minimum} or newer.
main.error.youtubeExtraction: YouTube extraction failed. Restart the app and retry with the bundled current yt-dlp. If it continues, YouTube may require authentication for this video.
main.error.youtubeForbidden: YouTube rejected the video data request (HTTP 403). Retrying with a fresh URL also failed. This video may require a PO Token or browser authentication.
main.error.tempFileMissing: Could not find the downloaded temporary file.
main.error.rendererUrl: Could not determine the renderer server URL.
main.error.workerStart: Could not start or connect to the download worker.
main.error.queueTooLarge: The download queue state is too large.
preview.liveUnsupported: Live recording is not supported. Use a completed video or replay.
cookies.chzzkGuide: Extract from a browser signed into CHZZK with your Naver account. Public videos can work without cookies. Restricted videos require valid login and viewing permission. Only CHZZK cookies and Naver login cookies (NID_AUT/NID_SES) are retained, separately from YouTube. Never share these credentials.
cookies.chzzkLoginPresent: Naver login cookies are saved for preview and download requests. This does not verify session validity or viewing permission.
cookies.chzzkLoginMissing: Naver login cookies are missing or incomplete. Public videos may work; extract again if authentication is required.
ytDlpUpdate.unavailable: No usable yt-dlp is available. Check your connection and retry the update. For development, run pnpm binaries:prepare to prepare the base binaries.
integration.dev.chooseHelp: Select the Kawaikara checkout containing package.json. Only that checkout’s running DEV host will be used.
